name: s5

ids.s5: S5 (S3Net), fold-1 MODA checkpoint, authors' inference recipe, stage-free
ids.s5_ens: S5, mean softmax of the five MODA fold checkpoints, same post-processing

method.citation: S5: Self-Supervised Learning Boosts Sleep Spindle Detection in Single-Channel EEG via Temporal Segmentation, IEEE TBME 2026

source.relation: authors' repository cloned into detectors/s5/src, unmodified; run.py imports its model and post-processing

command: git clone https://github.com/Adrenaline613/S5 detectors/s5/src && git -C detectors/s5/src checkout e31fb2e && cd detectors/s5 && uv sync && cd ../.. && detectors/s5/.venv/Scripts/python detectors/s5/run.py [--datasets dreams_spindles,nap] [--channels C3,...]
notes: Trained on MODA (MASS SS1/SS3 segments); DREAMS and NAP are not mentioned in the repository, so both scores are treated as out-of-sample. The paper full text was not accessible (2026-10-30).
